title: Gabriel's Vision of the Seventy Weeks
description: While Daniel prays and confesses his own sin and the sin of his people, the angel Gabriel flies to him at the time of the evening sacrifice to give him understanding. He reveals the prophecy of the seventy weeks decreed for his people and the holy city: Jerusalem will be rebuilt, an Anointed One will come and be cut off, and finally the city and the sanctuary will be destroyed.
